name: Sen no Hana, Sakihokoru Shiawase ~La Vie en Bouquet Coloré~
original_name: 千ノ華、咲き誇る幸セ ～La Vie en Bouquet Coloré～
source: Fan game featuring idol unit VelvetRose (Chitose Kurosaki and Chiyo Shirayuki) from THE iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: Starlight Stage.
translation: 粉丝游戏以《偶像大师灰姑娘女孩：星光舞台》中的偶像组合VelvetRose（黑崎千岁和白雪千代）为主角。
